fix_version: aioncore next release after 0.1.54 (NOT in the user's AionUi 2.1.43)
verification: log-confirmed second victim of the 3T0 encryption-key bug. Attachments (logs.gz 4MB, db-diagnostics.json) inspected: GET /api/providers repeatedly returns 400 'Decryption failed: invalid key or corrupted data' across the 04:00 session that produced the feedback. User is an upgrade user (startup-log-report 2026-07-29 on AionUi@2.1.42; feedback 2026-07-30 on 2.1.43). DB has 5 providers -> any one undecryptable row makes the whole list 400 (2.1.43 lacks #722's per-item lenient decrypt).
root_cause_summary: Same root cause as ELECTRON-3T0 (silent encryption-key rotation on migration). User-visible symptom '添加模型连接不了' decoded from logs: POST /api/providers returns 201 (add succeeds) but the immediately-following GET /api/providers returns 400 (list decrypt fails for the pre-existing rows), so the newly-added model never renders / appears unusable. fetch-models and detect-protocol both 200 => network path is fine; the failure is local list decryption. Timeline shows 2026-07-30 00:39 startup served providers 200 (a non-race startup: same DB decrypts fine, data NOT permanently lost), then 01:01 startup onward stayed 400 across 04:00/05:44/07:00 restarts (high per-machine race hit-rate). CAVEAT confirmed against 3T0 note: providers created DURING a broken session (this user POSTed 201 several times while the list was 400) are encrypted under the in-memory wrong key and become permanently undecryptable even after a good restart; those rows must be deleted and re-added.
